name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement for RTP
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

> **Solo Developer Disclaimer:** I maintain this project alone with limited time. Requests that duplicate existing functionality, lack a clear use-case, or conflict with the plugin's design goals will be closed without a response. Please read the [docs](../../docs/FOR_SERVER_ADMINS.md) before submitting.

**1. Problem / Motivation**
What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected and how often?
<!-- e.g. "Server admins running Folia cannot limit the fill queue per region at runtime without restarting." -->

**2. Proposed Solution**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include any command syntax, config key names, or API surface you envision.

**3. Alternatives Considered**
What workarounds exist today? Why are they insufficient?

**4. Scope & Compatibility**
- Does this affect all platforms (Spigot / Paper / Folia) or only one?
- Is this a breaking change to existing config files or the `rtp-api`?
- Would this require a new permission node or economy hook?

**5. Validation Checklist**
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate.
- [ ] I have read the [FAQ](../../docs/admin/FAQ.md) and [COMMANDS](../../docs/admin/COMMANDS.md) — this is not already supported.
- [ ] I understand this is a volunteer project and there is no guaranteed delivery timeline.
